name: ktranslate
what_it_is: ktranslate is a Kentik open-source agent that ingests network telemetry (SNMP polling, NetFlow/sFlow/IPFIX flow data, syslog, and streaming telemetry) and translates it into a variety of output formats for forwarding to observability sinks. It runs as a single Go binary or Docker container and supports enrichment, rollups, filtering, and sampling before export.
components: SNMP poller (device metrics and interface counters via YAML device config)
Flow collector (NetFlow v5/v9, IPFIX, sFlow listener on configurable UDP port, default 9995)
protocols: AWS SQS (event trigger for S3 objects)
measurement: Flow bytes and packets per flow record
SNMP interface counters and device metrics
Sampling rate applied to flow records

Flow field set: TimeReceived, SamplingRate, Bytes, Packets, SrcAddr, DstAddr, Proto, SrcPort, DstPort, InIf, OutIf, SrcVlan, DstVlan, TCPFlags, SrcAS, DstAS, Type, SamplerAddress (default), plus MPLS, VRF, ICMP, and custom integer/bytes fields
configuration: YAML config file (config.yaml) mirrors all CLI flags; flags take precedence
SNMP devices defined in a separate YAML file (-snmp flag or KT_SNMP_PATH env var)
Flow field inclusion list configurable via -nf.message.fields
Custom NetFlow field mappings via -nf.mapping YAML file
Filters via -filters (type dimension operator value syntax)
fault_injection: No built-in fault injection primitives documented
Flow-only mode (-flow_only) disables SNMP polling, allowing isolated flow testing
SNMP walk mode (-snmp_do_walk) targets a single device and exits, useful for probing
Single-poll mode (-snmp_poll_now) runs one SNMP poll for a specified device and exits
-nr_estimate_only records New Relic payload sizes without actually sending data
modes: SNMP polling mode (default when snmp yaml provided)
Scheduled SNMP discovery (-snmp_discovery_min interval in minutes)
Local file processing mode (-aws_local_file, processes file and exits)
constraints: Requires a MaxMind license key at Docker image build time for GeoIP enrichment; without it geo enrichment is unavailable
SNMP device list must be supplied as an external YAML file; no built-in device auto-detection without enabling discovery mode
docker-compose example is hardcoded for New Relic sink only; other sinks require manual command construction
Flow listener binds to 0.0.0.0:9995 by default; host network mode required in Docker to receive external flow traffic
Rollup export and alpha/raw flows cannot be sent to separate sinks independently without the -rollup_and_alpha flag
No native TLS termination for flow input; SSL only applies to HTTP serving endpoints (-ssl_cert_file / -ssl_key_file)
docker_services: ktranslate (image: kentik/ktranslate:v2, network_mode: host, restart: unless-stopped)
notable_absences: No docker-compose for non-New Relic sinks (Kafka, Prometheus, InfluxDB) in the official deployment examples
No built-in flow replay or pcap ingestion capability
No native alerting or threshold-based notifications
No web UI — management is entirely CLI/config-file-driven
gNMI/streaming telemetry support not detailed in README (mentioned in entry description but not in flags/config)
